race.comment: PLAGIARISM (5) four-start Maiden who resumes a gelding. Gave his all in Group company over the two preps and looks ready to go with the two sharp trial placings. Poorly drawn again and has the ability to get over from the wide draw. Go close. HITCH (4) shouldn't be a Maiden for long after the two solid runs. Stalked the speed and never gave up with a close third over 1300m at Kembla Grange. Set to peak and no excuses here. SECRETS WITHIN (13) is a well-related three-year-old filly by I Am Invincible from the former top race mare Eloping on debut for the Archibald yard. Fitted with the two good trials and market moves must be closely monitored. YOUR COLOUR (14) Maurice filly resuming. Bumped into Bangkok Hottie on debut when sixth over 1200m at Warwick Farm last April. Fitted with the two trials and must be kept safe. SCHUMACHER (7) Stay Inside colt from Schwesterherz on debut for the Michael Freedman yard. Given time to mature and has trialled okay. The chances don't end there.
